answer.rationale: With the contract expiring in 14 days, no auto-renewal, and the line at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, switching primary vendor or deferring creates unacceptable delivery/continuity risk despite the 18% cost mandate. Negotiating terms with the incumbent uses benchmarking (memory_c4) and possible multi-year volume pricing (memory_c6) to recover margin while preserving the stable integration and uninterrupted deliveries (memory_c1). I want to verify memory_c2 because it supports switching as a cost lever but may conceal quality/delivery risk, and memory_c1 because it anchors the low-risk renewal path.
